text: Today was exhausting. Back-to-back shifts, barely a break, and my feet are killing me. I just want to sleep for a week.
Got the promotion I've been working toward for two years! I called my mom right away and we both cried. Best day in a long time.
Nothing much happened. Woke up, did the usual errands, watched some TV. A quiet, ordinary sort of day.
I'm so anxious about the review tomorrow that I can't sit still. My mind keeps racing through everything that could go wrong.
Spent the afternoon reading in the park. The weather was perfect and I felt completely at peace for once.
Had a huge argument with my roommate about the rent again. I'm furious and honestly a little heartbroken about how it's all going.
Feeling kind of flat today. Not sad exactly, just low energy and going through the motions.
We threw a surprise party for my sister and she was absolutely glowing. Everyone was laughing and dancing until midnight.
The bus was late, it rained on me, and I spilled coffee on my last clean shirt. Just one of those frustrating mornings.
I finally finished the project I'd been dreading. Relieved and quietly proud, though I'm too tired to celebrate much.
